section.34: The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten

34.name_native: The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten

hadiths.text: Adi b. Hatim reported:I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about Mi'rad (i. e. hunting with the help of arrow having a stub end, and he stated the same (as we find in the previous hadith)
